about: The Orbit as one painted realm (owner, 2026-11-22: the solar system was 'the wrong idea' and 'looks cheap'; he chose 'one painted realm map'). One panoramic matte painting where every pillar is a place; the app pans and zooms across it with live depth and light (deck/views/realm.js) and puts each pillar's tap target on its landmark. Painted by Claude with Nano Banana Pro (tools/art/realm.py), checked by eye, fixed by edits where a landmark is missing.
prompt:
An ultra-wide cinematic matte painting of a hidden mountain valley realm at blue hour, seen from a high vantage point, like the world map of a AAA game. A calm river runs through the middle of the valley toward the viewer and widens into a still lagoon in the lower right. At the exact centre of the valley rises a slender pearl-white spire on a small island in the river, crowned by a softly glowing pearl sphere of light with a faint ice-cyan corona: the heart of the realm. Around it, spread across the whole width of the valley and clearly separated from each other, stand twenty-seven distinct landmarks, each lit by its own small warm or coloured light so it can be picked out from afar.

LEFT THIRD (the old quarter of finance, warm gold and green light): a classical marble bank with bronze doors and a gold glow; a dark walnut museum with rows of softly glowing display windows; a long low shipping depot with stacked crates and a loading crane; a tall dark hall from whose roof a smooth ribbon of green light pours down into a pool; and at the far left edge, on a high stone cliff, a great pair of feathered wings mounted on a dark stand facing the sky.

CENTRE BACK, on the slopes and peaks behind the spire (the hill of the mind, lavender and violet light): a white observatory dome open to the stars on the highest peak; a vast round library with a glass dome full of starlight; a monumental clock tower with a huge brass ring dial; a stone forge with four chimneys glowing in four colours; an inventor's workshop with blueprint-blue light spilling from tall windows; a small arcade hall with screens glowing in many colours; a slim storyteller's tower with candlelit windows; a pale-columned training temple on a terrace; and a seaside lounge with a black grand piano visible under a warm lamp.

CENTRE FRONT, beside the river (the civic square, cool ice light): a civic hall with a classical portico and a brass balance scale; a post tower whose facade is a wall of small glowing mail cubbies; a tower made of tall hanging glass panes; a squat vault keep with a single gold seal light; and a still pool with one floating violet sphere of light.

RIGHT THIRD (the mountain homestead, ice blue and amber light): a mountain house with a wooden deck lit by warm lamps; a modern glass garage with a dark blue SUV and a black motorcycle parked inside under white light; a log cabin ready-station with lanterns and a radio mast; a family home with a warm yellow kitchen window; an archive tower with rows of softly glowing file windows; a high mountain pass at the far right with a small weather mast and a wind vane; a harbour on the lagoon with a small expedition ship at a lit pier; and a tower crowned by a giant round glass lens like an eye catching sea-green light.

Every landmark is distinct, readable as what it is, and none overlap; small lit paths and bridges connect them. The sky is deep midnight blue fading to pearl at the horizon with the first stars. Mist lies in the valley floor between the districts.
style: Cinematic key art for a AAA game's world map, made as a photoreal matte painting: real materials, volumetric light and haze, deep blacks that still hold detail, a filmic colour grade, tack sharp from edge to edge. The Prometheus palette: deep midnight blue-black lit with pearl white, ice cyan and soft lavender, each district adding its own accent. Futuristic but grounded and elegant; never cartoon, never clip-art, never a flat illustration, never cluttered neon.
negative: no readable text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, map labels or interface; no people, faces or hands; no watermark, border or frame; no cartoon, toy or plastic 3D-render look; no oversaturation or HDR halos; no tilted horizon, fisheye or tilt-shift blur
